integrity: Mathematical proof uses exact displayed Hessian, resolvent, group action and character sums; finite-prime consistency checks are not an all-prime-power proof.
scientific_limitations: Only nonharmonic marked coefficients in finite fields q congruent to 3 mod 4 of characteristic at least five. Counts distinct rational flex supports, not geometric isomorphism classes, twists or curve zeta functions. Historical priority may have unindexed equivalents.
title: Rational inflection spectra of the cyclic-quartic generalized Legendre pencil
